title.en: The One With the Reformulated Perfume

description.es: Digna ofrece a Begoña refugiarse con sus hijos en Mafinca, y Marta acepta. Más tarde, en la fábrica, Marta y Digna ponen a prueba la propuesta de Gabriel y Tasio de abaratar la fórmula de los perfumes y, a su pesar, comprueban que el olor no cambia. Sin embargo, Marta enfrenta a Tasio, reprochándole su alianza con Gabriel y todas sus traiciones hacia la familia.
description.en: Digna offers Begoña the chance to take shelter with her children at Mafinca, and Marta agrees. Later, at the factory, Marta and Digna test Gabriel and Tasio's proposal to make the perfume formula cheaper and, to their dismay, confirm that the scent doesn't change. Even so, Marta confronts Tasio, reproaching him for his alliance with Gabriel and all his betrayals of the family.
